reviews.text:
MyPet did an amazing job grooming our dog, Diesel! He came home looking like a completely new dog and smelling great! We could tell he was treated with patience and care. The staff was friendly, professional, and made the entire experience easy. We’ll definitely be bringing Diesel back. If you need your pet groomed to I'd highly recommend using MyPet. Definitely my lifetime pet groomer! Thank you for the great service Evelina!!!
The before and after pictures say it all!

1st time going here cause my regular groomer kept canceling and I must say they did a awesome job on both my yorkies they look amazing I have extremely pleased with the service and the lady was really nice will be going back for sure

I absolutely love the job they did on my 7 year old kitty!
So glad I found this place and would highly recommend.

I have been bringing my dog to MyPet since he was a puppy and he always looks gorgeous after he’s been groomed by Ewelina and her team! She’s very gentle with him, and he’s never stressed out about coming here. I’ll never go anywhere else!
I've never seen my dog leave a groomer happy. But she came out wagging her tail and jumping into the owners arms. Very nice business. They will be my regular groomer from here out
My cat got shaved and he looks so cute. This was his 2nd time. Both times he looked great.  Cash or Venmo no cards accepted.

I am a dog foster and picked up an extremely matted doodle on short notice. After posting on FB for recommendations, My Pet reached out with a next-day appointment. Our dog was sooooo matted, and they took such good care of him for such a reasonable fee. He’s now ready for adoption!

She treats my cats so well! So sweet and super nice. I feel confident my cats are safe and well taken care of. I get nail trims and sanitary trims. She's quick, efficient & the best!!! Lyla and floralina love you ! ❤️

I have never been happier with a groomer nor have I had a better experience than with My Pet on Allegheny! Their attention to detail is unmatched, they’re the nicest ppl and you can tell they love animals! Not only were they quick, efficient, and kind, but the cut they gave Pete is the best I have ever experienced with him in 11 years. Pete is a big boy, and not the nicest especially to strangers. The fact that he looks and smells amazing, usually after the groomer he’s cranky and upset, but today all cuddles and loving. Thank you ladies so, so much! I’ll definitely have Pete come there moving forward and our 3 others!
My Pet does an excellent job grooming my Cavapoo Bear. He comes back happy, clean and she cuts the length to your requested length. She often has appointments without a long wait time to book.

Costumer service was excellent, prices were decently competitive especially for a private shop, and the grooming was great.

Love the way my dogs hair came out and loved the way she smelled when I picked her up. Will definitely be coming back soon for my dog and even my cat in the future.

10/10 recommend. (Dog- Bella)
Did a great job grooming my dog! Pricing is very reasonable and she was able to be very accommodating with my schedule. My pup left very happy too :)

Took Princess Sage there to get her nails clipped because she don’t let us do them. I called last minute and Ewelina was able to squeeze me in. She takes her time and does a great job. Not to mention she’s so caring with the animals. Sage loves her 💕

Ewalina is so sweet and took such good care of my golden retriever Bonnie. She absolutely LOVED her groom here! She was so happy when I picked her up and so beautiful and clean! I am blown away. I will definitely be bringing her back again. ♥️🐾 Very reasonably priced as well. Thank you! ♥️😊 …
Great service and great with our cat
I am SO happy with how my cat came out, I couldn’t believe Ewelina was able to get every single not off him without one nick from the clippers! Words can’t explain my satisfaction
Took my yorkie chanel for a hair cut and it’s  perfect! The stylist was very sweet, great customer service. Definitely recommend!!

I have been bringing my Cavapoo puppy here for his last 4 hair cuts every 8 weeks. They do an amazing job! He’s always so happy when I pick him up and he looks perfect. He always grows in really nice. We will never take him anywhere else!
I’ve been coming here now for a few months.  She always does a good job.  My dog Cider always comes out looking beautiful.  Will continue using them for further grooming services.

I just picked up my 4 month old shih Tzu boys.  Words cannot express how very happy I am with their beautiful first puppy trim!!!! I will be back in a couple of weeks with my little girl, Gracie.  Thank you very much MyPet!! You now have a steady customer of a mommy of three shih Tzu puppies 🩵🩵❤️ …
She did such an amazing job my cat looks and smells amazing. Such a great experience I will be back again for sure.
This place is awesome! Took two cats here to get lion cuts, neither are a huge fan of being picked up / brushed. And they came back looking great. Pricing was more than reasonable.

The did a fabulous job on my Pomeranian!! Her hair is so silky and perfect. I’ve had nightmare experiences with other groomers and My Pet blew my expectations out of the park!! I highly recommend and will come here again and again! The pricing is also incredibly fair. Thank you for a fantastic experience! :)
